figures.finding: The Falklands' 1967 Employment of Women, Young Persons and Children Ordinance, applied to the Dependencies by the Application of Colony Laws Ordinance 1967, defines a child as under fourteen and bars a child's employment in an industrial undertaking or on a ship; it sets no rule for other work, performing included, so no rule reaches a child performer there.

value.follows: FK (Falkland Islands Ordinance No. 1 of 1967, applied by the Dependencies' Application of Colony Laws Ordinance 1967)

figures.applies: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands (no permanent population). Later amendments of 1968 and 1978 are on the site and weren't read; the scanned Cap. 24 Employment of Children wasn't read.
